facts.fact: Caren 在 Yumi 门廊上想不起那个女人的名字，记忆空白让她一阵恐慌
facts.anchor: The woman’s name slips away like water through a sieve

facts.fact: Yumi 坚称那晚看见 Van 和一个女孩在一起，并让 Caren 别把 Noah 拖进来
facts.anchor: I know what I saw. Van was with a girl.

facts.fact: 聊到子女升学时 Caren 说这个街区没人满足于"还行"
facts.anchor: No one in this neighborhood has ever been satisfied with fine

facts.fact: Caren 直接对 Yumi 说出自己是被下药的
她把随时想哭归因于脑震荡的后遗症
Finn 就是周日早上在泥地里发现她的人
facts.anchor: The man who found me in the mud.

facts.fact: Finn 转述 Bonnie 的话：Yumi 曾说那个保姆在"搞外遇"
facts.anchor: Actually, the word she used was ‘affair.’

facts.fact: Finn 承认死者 Autumn 是他的密友，还是他劝她搬来这个街区的
facts.anchor: Autumn was a really close friend of mine.

facts.fact: Yumi 想起见过有人穿树篱进那栋房子的一次，是七月四日周末的周六
facts.anchor: the Saturday of the July Fourth weekend

facts.fact: 结尾 Caren 觉得自己正从旁观者变成参与者
